page.overview:
Who is Chatty Mr. Spell Book?

Chatty Mr. Spell Book is a character in WarioWare: Smooth Moves.

Chatty Mr. Spell Book is an old-looking, brown, living spell book with a skull on his cover.

Chatty Mr. Spell Book appears in Ashley's stage, The Loquacious Spell Book, the title of which even references Chatty Mr. Spell Book.

In the stage's opening cutscene, when Ashley unsuccessfully attempts to convert a flower sprout into a carnivorous plant, Chatty Mr. Spell Book appears to try and help her. He appears in the intermissions between while the player plays through Ashley's set of microgames.
